items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know Eubie Blake's still going. Eubie's 93 now, I think. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he's still going, eh?

ctx.x: Yes, sir. That's my influence. I put God first and then after that, then I have to take all the rest of them. You know, one time I had a mind to doing an act like this, when I would go out there and started singing and I'd sing a part of it and I'd tell Louis to come in and you do your part, Louis. Then I'd sing like Louis, and I'd -- I would say, hey, now, look out, Randy, now you take this one. Then I would start to singing, you know, one of those things. Well, I don't know. I get to thinking, well, here I'm…
I guess so. I know Eubie
Blake's still going. Eubie's 93 now, I think.
